listing.name: Hullmod Barratry
listing.summary: Adds V-Mods and Scuff-Mods for intentional ship customization with balanced trade-offs and cosmetic effects.
listing.aiSummary: Adds V-Mods and Scuff-Mods for intentional ship customization with balanced trade-offs and cosmetic effects.

description: To keep relevance in the base game's D-Mods, if you have a V-Mod equipped on your ship and that ship happens to blow up and gain the counterpart hullmod, the V-Mod will be removed and replaced with it. Afterwards just remove the conflict hullmod and you're golden. Unfortunately damage mods are no longer removable, that can only be done with V-Mods, as the workers that damaged it feel bad for you and just pay for the repair fees off their own backs!

aiDescription: Adds the ability to intentionally apply V-Mods, which are balanced counterparts to base game D-Mods, to ship hulls. These V-Mods provide half the benefits and drawbacks of D-Mods, allowing players to customize their ships with controlled trade-offs. Also introduces Scuff-Mods, cosmetic damage effects that mimic D-Mod appearances without altering stats.
